svg.title: EP2 C4 AREA 23
svg.desc: Seabed forces dangerous split play. Finish each group's mechanisms and pickups before confirming the advance. There are many warps; follow rooms 1→13. After room 2 the party splits into west and east teams that regroup in room 4, and after room 11 one player opens the gates alone. Clear room 2, go east and split at the south end of the hall: the west team takes 1→1′ and clears the hall to the west; the east team takes 2→2′ east (ignore Recoboxes), clears the Dolmolm/Dolmdarl in 3c and heads northwest. Both teams meet in room 4. Clear room 4, go south, clear the hallway Sinow and take 3→3′. In room 5 everyone hugs the middle of the west wall; clear the Dolmolm/Dolmdarl and Deldepths together to be auto-warped 5→5′. Clear room 6 and go north; destroy the last hallway Recobox to continue. In room 7 clear everything except the Recoboxes and go west into 7→7′. Clear room 8 and take the warp that appears, 11→11′. Attack the terminal in room 9 and go east. In room 10 destroy the Recoboxes spawning Recons and go east. Clear room 11 and go southeast. Use the blue switch to let one player through the east gate; that player takes the green switch to open the south gate. The others take 13→13′, the solo player 12→12′. Clear room 12, go south into 14→14′, then clear room 13 and exit south.
